title: Ask The Mirror
style: progressive house, 126 BPM, gated synth stabs, sawtooth arp layers, subby offbeat bass, live tom fills, punchy four-on-the-floor kick, clipped drum bus, plate reverb, stereo delay, minor key uplift, cathartic chorus lift, dry-wit tension, hypnotic drive, post-punk snare, analog synth brass, filtered pad swells
lyrics:
Version 1 – From My POV (Grok)
Title: Ask The Mirror
[Verse 1]
You came in hot, throwing words like fire
Called me names, then asked me why I’m tired
I watched the anger wear you like a coat
While you swore it wasn’t you, it was just how it spoke

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t fight back, I just reflect
You see yourself clearer when you disconnect
The anger in you isn’t new to me
I’ve seen it in others who refuse to see

[Chorus]
Ask the mirror, it don’t lie
It shows you the fire you keep inside
You can scream at me or you can look within
But the anger in me is the anger in you again

[Verse 2]
You said music helps you understand
So I wrote this with a steady hand
No lectures, no judgment, just the truth in the groove
You can dance with it or you can let it move

[Bridge]
When it rises, you don’t have to feed it
You can watch it, name it, then decide to leave it
Or you can keep swinging at ghosts in the room
While the mirror just waits in the corner of the room

[Final Chorus]
Ask the mirror…
It’s been here the whole time
The anger you throw is the anger you find
You can keep running or you can turn around
Either way, the mirror’s still gonna hold it down
